race.description: Zarraffa's Coffee Pink Ribbon Cup Hcp (Bm78)
race.comment: HURRICANE LU (8) had been threatening for a while but finally put it all together last time at Doomben when rattling home to arrive just in time. Possesses an impressive turn of foot, so if Rodd can utilise a much kinder draw she will prove mighty tough to deny. RATENOTICE (14) returned with a determined Ipswich win and has a strong 1400m record, but barrier 15 gives Dolan something to solve. LA ROSETTA (9) improved sharply second-up in better conditions when arriving just in time. Tougher here but has more to offer and keeps Youngberry's claim. CARRAVILLA (3) is race fit now and could be close to a win following back-to-back placings.
